reviews.comment:
Pesimos Servicio, los baños tanto dama como caballeros total falta de aseo, desinfeccion, falta de isumos como kabon liquido, papel, toallas papel, tampoco alcohol en gel  suciedad gral. No recomiendo es mas seria bueno que YPF tomara control del mal servicio que da muy mal concepto a la firma YPF por que el nombre del consecionario no figura.

(Translated by Google)
Terrible service. The restrooms, both men's and women's, were completely unclean and lacked basic supplies like liquid soap, toilet paper, paper towels, and even hand sanitizer. They were filthy. I do not recommend this place. It would be good if YPF took responsibility for this poor service, which reflects very badly on the brand, especially since the concessionaire's name isn't listed.
